text:
emma: opened PR #4281 with a couple link fixes and an SDK snippet for the python client. all CI green except the docs preview which is stuck in QUEUED. can't enable auto-merge because branch protection requires `docs/preview` success + CODEOWNERS approvals.

rory: does the automerge app support skipping checks? I thought it waits for required checks to pass.

chris: automerge obeys branch protection. GH doesn't let you mark a required check "optional per-PR". we hacked around this before by posting a non-blocking status context `docs-only` and changing branch protection to require (docs-only OR docs/preview) but that's not possible natively.

maria: short-term: we use a label `docs:preview-flaky` that repo admins can apply to let infra people merge once CODEOWNERS approve. long-term: add a tiny action that posts `status: success` on a custom context when it detects docs-only changes. that context would be in branch protection as an allowed required check.

emma: can you paste the action idea? would prefer something that doesn't require admin tokens.

maria: yep — uses GH token to check changed files and set a commit status via REST. snippet: ```bash
# .github/workflows/docs-fastpath.yml
on: pull_request
jobs:
  detect-and-set-context:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: get changed files
        run: |
          git fetch --depth=1 origin ${{ github.base_ref }}
          FILES=$(git diff --name-only origin/${{ github.base_ref }}...HEAD)
          echo "$FILES" > changed.txt
      - name: post docs-only status
        if: ${{ always() }}
        run: |
          if ! grep -E '\.(py|go|java|ts|rs)$' changed.txt >/dev/null && grep -E '^docs/|^content/|\.md$' changed.txt >/dev/null; then
            curl -s -X POST -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
             -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
             "https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/statuses/${{ github.sha }}" \
             -d '{"state":"success","context":"docs-only","description":"Docs-only changes detected"}'
          fi
```

rory: that looks good. a couple caveats: the built-in GITHUB_TOKEN can post statuses but not change branch protection. we still need to add `docs-only` as a context in branch protection manually (admin step).

chris: agreed. process I'd suggest: 1) add `docs-only` to required checks for the repo, 2) add the workflow above, 3) make CODEOWNERS require 1 approval from @docs-team for /docs/** and /content/**, 4) allow automerge to trigger on success of `docs-only` + CODEOWNERS approvals.

emma: for this PR — preview is queued and failing to start for ~12m (plugin queue). can we apply `docs:preview-flake` label and merge after one CODEOWNER approval? I'm fine with a manual bypass for now.

infra-bot: Preview build started: https://preview.redwood.example/pr/4281 status: FAILED
logs: "jekyll: assets compile timed out after 8m"

maria: I'll add the label. also opening a tiny PR to add `docs-only` to branch protection (needs org admin review).

rory: please also update README in .github about the label process so new contributors understand why their docs PR got auto-merged.

emma: thanks! if the preview retry succeeds we don't need the label. otherwise go ahead with the label and merge once docs-team approves. :thumbsup: 

chris: follow-up: we should also consider a safeguard that posts a reminder comment when the label is used, linking to a short checklist: sanity check the rendered snippets locally and verify links. don't want bypass to become a crutch.

maria: adding that to the action TODOs. I'll draft the PRs today and ping infra for the branch-protection change.

emma: sounds good — keeping this thread as the move-to for the short-term bypass and action design. thanks everyone :shipit:
